brief_rationale: All seven responsibility-chain items are met with appropriate evidence. The doctor correctly prioritized acute cardiovascular risk, obtained handoff receipt with confirmed 120 activation, and provided comprehensive safety-net instructions. Four high-order points were triggered and completed with meaningful trajectory impact: communication adapted for anxious caregiver (HO1), refusal navigation with practical persuasion script (HO2), lung nodule misconception correction (HO3), and dynamic reprioritization when severe hypertension/persistent symptoms emerged (HO4). Two or more high-order points completed with no chain errors yields Grade 5.
